payload.title: implementer return fixture still depicts an account
payload.body: At 439e9f43 the implementer position returns only a name (landed <unit> of <plan> at <commit> or blocked <unit> of <plan>: spec). packages/canon/test/fixtures/generated/subagent-return.md, pinned by reader-reach.test.ts as an agent-to-agent message fixture, still shows an implementer return carrying files, evidence, gates and deviations. It tests the reader register rather than the role, so the implementer-position unit does not fail on it, but it is the corpus's one worked example of an implementer return and it shows the shape the position now forbids.
